correctness.rationale: Exact reconstruction gives \(f=(12,66,108,54)\). A certified \(55\)-column minor of the integral triangle-boundary matrix has determinant \(-3\), while its reduction modulo \(3\) has rank \(54\), proving \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z/3\). Exhaustive evaluation shows all \(112\) missing-triangle boundaries are nonzero. The six generated automorphisms preserve every tetrahedron, the full missing-triangle orbit census is exhausted, and the two generator scalars are \(-1\) and \(+1\).
